summaryEn: Presidential and parliamentary elections are held on the same day every five years. The last joint election was 14 May 2023. The next ordinary election falls in 2028; a decision read on 17 October 2026 did not print the polling day. This release has the national page and 81 provinces, in Turkish and English.
llmsLine: Turkey in this release: national pages and 81 provinces (il), in Turkish and English. District, municipality, village, and neighbourhood pages are not published.
